name: Carboplatin + Paclitaxel + Bevacizumab (with maintenance Bevacizumab) for Epithelial Ovarian/Fallopian Tube/Primary Peritoneal Cancer (GOG-218)
cyclesNote: 6 cycles of carboplatin/paclitaxel; bevacizumab 15 mg/kg starting cycle 2 day 1 and continued every 21 days for up to 22 cycles total (concurrent plus maintenance) per GOG-218

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic carboplatin/paclitaxel backbone is not biomarker restricted. Bevacizumab is an anti-VEGF antibody, not biomarker gated. BRCA1/2 and HRD status are tested to guide maintenance strategy (bevacizumab, a PARP inhibitor, or the olaparib plus bevacizumab combination) after this therapy. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer, OV-5 and Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy (OV-D).

histology: epithelial ovarian carcinoma (histology-agnostic backbone; high-grade serous, endometrioid, clear cell, mucinous, carcinosarcoma). Fallopian tube and primary peritoneal carcinoma are staged and treated as ovarian carcinoma and share this regimen.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling before each dose.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: carboplatin moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
G-CSF: assess febrile neutropenia risk per institutional and NCCN growth factor guidance.
bevacizumab: manage per anti-VEGF safety - hypertension and proteinuria surveillance, wound-healing and GI-perforation/fistula precautions.
monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle for carboplatin AUC dosing
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle for PACLitaxel

bevacizumab: blood pressure at each visit and urine protein monitoring (proteinuria); watch for bleeding, thromboembolism, and GI perforation or fistula (GOG-240 reported higher grade 2+ hypertension, grade 3+ VTE, and fistula with bevacizumab)

doseModificationRules.condition: uncontrolled hypertension, grade 3+ proteinuria, GI perforation/fistula, or serious bleeding
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or permanently discontinue bevacizumab per anti-VEGF safety guidance; physician decides.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12 (GOG-218). PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV on day 1, before carboplatin, every 21 days for 6 cycles. 3 hr infusion cross referenced to DeVita 12th ed. line 178646. Corticosteroid plus H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Bevacizumab (GOG-218) (Paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV followed by Carboplatin AUC 6 IV Day 1)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12 (GOG-218). CARBOplatin target AUC 6 IV on day 1, every 21 days for 6 cycles. Dosed to target AUC (Calvert formula). Tall man per ISMP.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Bevacizumab (GOG-218) (Carboplatin AUC 6 IV Day 1)

drugs.name: Bevacizumab
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12 (GOG-218). Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg IV, STARTING day 1 of cycle 2, every 21 days for up to 22 cycles (concurrent then maintenance). No dose cap. Source-stated alternative (ICON-7, OV-D 7 of 12): Paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 followed by Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 IV and Bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg IV day 1, repeat every 21 days x 5 to 6 cycles, then continue bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg for up to 12 additional cycles.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
